lyrics.ja: 「なんであなたにはできないの？」なんてさ
lyrics.romaji: 「Nande Anata ni ha Dekinai no?」 Nante sa
lyrics.en: "Why can't you do it?"—they say things like that
lyrics.zh: 「為什麼你做不到呢？」之類的話

lyrics.ja: 陰口言われたり　呆れられたり
lyrics.romaji: Kageguchi Iwaretari Akireraretari
lyrics.en: People badmouth me behind my back, or get exasperated with me
lyrics.zh: 被人背後說閒話，被人投以無奈目光

lyrics.ja: 口角下がる DAY BY DAYS
lyrics.romaji: Koukaku Sagaru DAY BY DAYS
lyrics.en: My lips turn downward, day by days
lyrics.zh: 嘴角下垂的每一天

lyrics.ja: 電車はわたしを置き去りにしちゃうし
lyrics.romaji: Densha ha Watashi wo Okizari ni Shichau shi
lyrics.en: The train leaves me behind
lyrics.zh: 電車也把我拋在後頭

lyrics.ja: 葉物野菜もスピード速すぎだね
lyrics.romaji: Hamono Yasai mo Supiido Hayasugi Da ne
lyrics.en: Even leafy vegetables go out of season too fast
lyrics.zh: 葉菜類的保鮮速度也太快了呢

lyrics.ja: ありのままの素敵さだけじゃ　足りないんだ I T8KE ME
lyrics.romaji: Ari no Mama no Sutekisa Dake ja Tarinai n Da I T8KE ME
lyrics.en: Just being naturally lovely isn't enough—I take me
lyrics.zh: 光靠真實的美好還不夠，I T8KE ME

lyrics.ja: 毎日死ぬほど頑張って　やっとここまで連れてきたんだ
lyrics.romaji: Mainichi Shinu Hodo Ganbatte Yatto Koko made Tsurete Kita n Da
lyrics.en: I've worked myself to death every day and finally made it this far
lyrics.zh: 每天拚命努力，好不容易才走到這裡

lyrics.ja: あなたにわからない　わかってほしくない
lyrics.romaji: Anata ni Wakaranai Wakatte Hoshikunai
lyrics.en: You don't understand—and I don't want you to
lyrics.zh: 你不會懂，也不希望你懂

lyrics.ja: わたしの苦労も　苦悩も　どうかご存知ないでいてね？
lyrics.romaji: Watashi no Kurou mo Kunou mo Dou ka Gozonji Nai de Ite ne?
lyrics.en: My hardships and my anguish—please stay unaware of them, okay?
lyrics.zh: 我的辛勞與苦惱，請你永遠別知道，好嗎？

lyrics.ja: 「きっとあなたにもできるはず」なんてさ
lyrics.romaji: 「Kitto Anata ni mo Dekiru Hazu」 Nante sa
lyrics.en: "I'm sure you can do it too"—they say
lyrics.zh: 「你一定也能做到」之類的話

lyrics.ja: 言うほど無責任にはなりたくない
lyrics.romaji: Iu Hodo Musekinin ni ha Naritakunai
lyrics.en: But I don't want to be as irresponsible as those words
lyrics.zh: 但我不想成為像那句話一樣不負責任的人

lyrics.ja: それでも死ぬほど頑張って　賭ける値打ちはあると思った
lyrics.romaji: Sore demo Shinu Hodo Ganbatte Kakeru Neuchi ha Aru to Omotta
lyrics.en: Even so, I thought it was worth betting on and gave it my all
lyrics.zh: 即使如此，我仍覺得值得賭上一切拚命努力

lyrics.ja: 投げ出したくなるよ　でも諦めたくはない
lyrics.romaji: Nagedashitaku Naru yo Demo Akirametaku ha Nai
lyrics.en: I feel like giving up, but I don't want to quit
lyrics.zh: 好想拋開一切，但我不願放棄

lyrics.ja: わたしの未来も　失敗も　ぜんぶわたしだけのもの
lyrics.romaji: Watashi no Mirai mo Shippai mo Zenbu Watashi Dake no Mono
lyrics.en: My future and my failures—all of it belongs only to me
lyrics.zh: 我的未來與失敗，全都只屬於我

lyrics.ja: あなたにわからない　わかってほしくない
lyrics.romaji: Anata ni Wakaranai Wakatte Hoshikunai
lyrics.en: You don't understand—and I don't want you to
lyrics.zh: 你不會懂，也不希望你懂

lyrics.ja: わたしの苦労も　苦悩も　どうかご存知ないで！
lyrics.romaji: Watashi no Kurou mo Kunou mo Dou ka Gozonji Nai de!
lyrics.en: My hardships and my anguish—please stay unaware of them!
lyrics.zh: 我的辛勞與苦惱，請你永遠別知道！

lyrics.ja: 投げ出したくなるよ　でも諦めたくはない
lyrics.romaji: Nagedashitaku Naru yo Demo Akirametaku ha Nai
lyrics.en: I feel like giving up, but I don't want to quit
lyrics.zh: 好想拋開一切，但我不願放棄

lyrics.ja: わたしの未来も　失敗も　ぜんぶ渡さないよ！
lyrics.romaji: Watashi no Mirai mo Shippai mo Zenbu Watasanai yo!
lyrics.en: My future and my failures—I won't hand any of it over!
lyrics.zh: 我的未來與失敗，全都不會交給任何人！

lyrics.ja: 気付かない　気付かないでいて
lyrics.romaji: Kizukanai Kizukanaide Ite
lyrics.en: Don't notice—please don't notice
lyrics.zh: 別發現，請別發現

lyrics.ja: 「かわいいだけ」のわたしでいたい
lyrics.romaji: 「Kawaii Dake」 no Watashi de Itai
lyrics.en: I want to stay as the "just cute" me
lyrics.zh: 我只想繼續當「只有可愛」的我
